results.title: Royal Enfield Himalayan 440 vs 450; All Specs Compared
results.description: Royal Enfield’s new Himalayan 440 revives the original’s simple formula at Rs 2.29 lakh (ex-showroom), while the Himalayan 450 offers more power, tech, and hardware. Here’s how they compare.

results.title: OneXPlayer X2 Mini Pro handheld console with SteamOS tested in AAA games
results.description: YouTuber ETA Prime has put Steam OS on the AMD Strix Halo-powered OneXPlayer X2 Mini Pro handheld gaming console and tested it in AAA games. The console proved to be an impressive gaming handheld, playing demanding titles like Crimson Desert at over 60 FPS.
